video_title: RIDICULOUS Domantas Sabonis trade report & Could the Kings reunite Kris & Keegan Murray?

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: debunking the fake Domantas Sabonis to Charlotte Hornets trade rumor
quotes.excerpt: the Sacramento Kings are set to finalize a deal to trade Domantas Sabonis to the Charlotte Hornets

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: There is this rumor going around that the Sacramento Kings are set to finalize a deal to trade Domantas Sabonis to the Charlotte Hornets. I am laughing because this account put out, and the only reason I am bringing it up is because I got 50 questions about it yesterday, it was Sabonis to the Hornets for Grady Dick and two first-round picks and somebody, I don't even remember what the hell it was.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: Apparently, it changed. I just don't know. I do know it is because these people are trying to get aggregation and interaction, retweets, this that, whatever. But there is no recourse for willfully being wrong. When you know you are making something up, I think there should be expensive speech. I think if you are going to make up rumors like that and you know that they are made up, I think you should have to go to jail.

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: reuniting twin brothers Chris and Keegan Murray on the Kings
quotes.excerpt: Why not reunite the twins? That is what I am saying.
quotes.quote: Since we are embarking on what I like to call the feel-good Sacramento Kings season with redemption stories and Ben Simmons, curtain calls for Zach LaVine in a contract year, DeAndre Hunter now with both eyes, thank God, doing his thing, there is a lot of real good human interest stories. Why not reunite the twins? That is what I am saying. I think they have both been in the NBA enough to where I could tell. I think if Chris and Keegan were dressed exactly the same and didn't even speak and they were sitting side by side, I am 99.9% sure I would know which one is Keegan.
